key_idea: In a tree each pair has a single path, so a DFS from every start node carrying the running product of 1/degree gives the centrality directly.
sketch: For each node i run a DFS; moving into neighbour w multiplies the carried value by 1/deg(w) and adds it to the sum. The centrality is 1 plus that sum and the answer is the average over all nodes. O(N^2) with N <= 100, doubles suffice. Corner case N=1 gives 1.
